view-from-theos-apartment

Rooftops, chimneys and a cloudy sky stretch over Paris as seen from the apartment where Van Gogh lived with his brother Theo. Van Gogh painted the view in 1887 with fresh, quick strokes after learning from the Impressionists. It's one of the first signs of his bright palette. It's a city view with a feeling of home.
tahitian-woman-with-a-flower

A woman in a long white dress holds a flower to her ear, in warm tropical light. Gauguin painted it soon after arriving in Tahiti. The simple, strong figure and bold colors show his new direction. It's a famous image of his first stay on the island.
fatata-te-miti

Two figures, one wading and one on the beach, are near the sea in Tahiti, with a pink tree arching overhead. The title means 'near the sea.' Gauguin built the picture out of flat, bold areas of color, like a Japanese print. It's a dreamy view of paradise.
sadko

A merchant, Sadko, is walking along the sea bottom in a magical underwater kingdom, as the Sea King's daughters parade past in dresses. It's based on a Russian folk tale, which inspired an opera, too. Repin painted the sea princesses with different faces from many nations. It's a fairy tale full of beauty.
skarga-s-sermon

A priest preaches to the king and nobles of Poland about their duties, warning them of dangers ahead. Piotr Skarga was a real preacher in the 1500s who warned of a decline. Matejko painted it to inspire Poles in a time of foreign rule. It's famous for its message of patriotism.
the-dance

Dancing figures in a circle, in a lively swirl of ancient costume. Bouguereau's graceful figures seem to move to music. It's a classical celebration of dance as part of life. The smooth surface and gentle poses are signatures of his style.
lady-lilith

A woman sits in front of a mirror, brushing her long golden hair, in a rich red-and-white room. In old legend, Lilith was Adam's first wife. Rossetti's painting is full of beautiful details, like flowers and a glowing mirror. It's a dreamy picture of beauty and mystery.
thatched-cottages-and-houses

Moss-covered roofs of old cottages cluster together in a village, with trees and a cloudy sky. Van Gogh painted it in Auvers-sur-Oise, in northern France, in 1890. He loved these old thatched houses. It reminds you of simple country life.
a-lane-near-arles

A sunny path curves through green fields lined with trees near the town of Arles. Van Gogh painted the bright scene in the summer light of southern France. The path draws the viewer into the picture. It's a peaceful stroll.
bazille-s-studio

Artists and friends gather in a bright studio full of paintings, including Manet, Monet and Renoir. Bazille painted the group that would form the Impressionists. The painting shows his friends before they became famous. It's like a family snapshot of art history.
the-age-of-innocence

A little girl sits in a landscape, her head tilted, with a sweet look of curiosity. Reynolds was the first president of the Royal Academy, and he often painted children. The soft light and fluffy dress capture childhood. It's one of the best-loved child portraits in English art.
the-ambassadors-of-agamemnon-in-the-tent-of-achilles

Greek messengers come to the tent of the hero Achilles, who sulks over a quarrel with his commander, begging him to return to the war. Ingres painted it at 20, as a prize piece in Paris. It's based on Homer's Iliad. It shows how well he'd learned the lessons of ancient sculpture.
jealousy

A pale man stares out in the foreground of a garden as a couple stands behind him. Munch painted jealousy as a green-faced mood. The painting is more about feeling than action. It's a revealing look at a strong emotion.
god-speed

A knight leans down from his horse as his lady ties a scarf around his arm and wishes him luck before battle. Edmund Blair Leighton painted such romantic scenes from the Middle Ages with great detail. This one is among the most popular. It's a picture of love and courage.
anxiety

A crowd of people with ghostly faces walk toward us under a blood-red sky on a bridge. Munch made this just after his most famous painting, The Scream, with similar colors. The mood is one of unease. It's a picture of worry that many people recognize.
man-proposes-god-disposes

Two polar bears prowl through the wreck of an Arctic expedition, gnawing at a torn flag and scattered supplies. Landseer painted this after the lost Franklin expedition. The title means we make plans but nature has the final say. It's a famous and very dramatic image.
josephine-eleonore-marie-pauline-de-galard-de-brassac-de-bea

A French princess sits in a blue satin dress with a pearl necklace and elegant poise. Ingres took a long time to paint her, and the dress is exquisitely detailed. The portrait is one of the most admired of the 1800s. It hangs in the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York.
our-english-coasts

Sheep graze on a bright green cliff above a blue sea, with sunlight on their wool. Hunt painted every blade of grass and animal in close detail. It was meant as a warning of an invasion — the sheep, he joked, were unprotected. It's a beautiful look at the English coast.
the-death-of-caesar

After being stabbed by senators in Rome, Julius Caesar's body lies in a theater, while the conspirators scatter. Gérôme painted an empty hall instead of the actual fight. The still, quiet scene is more haunting than a battle. It's a clever painting of a famous event.
two-crabs

Two crabs, one on its back, scuttle on a pale green background. Van Gogh painted them in Arles in 1889, using bright orange and green. He loved Japanese prints, which have many pictures of sea life. It's a charming study.
gabrielle-cot
A young girl with red hair looks out with soft, grave eyes, wearing a white dress. Bouguereau painted her in 1890. The soft realism is typical of his work. It's a sensitive portrait of a child.
portrait-of-a-violinist

A man in a green coat holds a violin as he glances out, with a bow in his hand. Anne Vallayer-Coster was a French painter, and one of the few women admitted to the French Royal Academy of Painting. She was famous for still lifes, and this is an unusual portrait. It's a lovely picture of music.
my-wife-s-lovers

A crowd of 42 cats, each with a different personality, poses on and around a luxurious cushion. Carl Kahler painted the cats of a rich woman in San Francisco, and the painting took three years. The cats' names are known, and the painting is a world record in cat portraits. It's a delight for cat lovers.
portrait-of-a-lady

A woman looks over her shoulder with a bold stare, wearing a patterned robe, set against a pale background. Klimt painted it at the end of his career. It was stolen from a museum in Italy in 1997 and mysteriously reappeared in 2019. It's one of the strangest art stories.
lilith

A woman with a snake wound around her body stands by a tree in a lush forest. John Collier painted Lilith, a character from old legends. The snake and soft light give it a dreamlike feel. It's an eye-catching Victorian painting.
portrait-of-elisabeth-lederer

A young woman in a white dress stands before a background of Chinese-style patterns and figures. Klimt painted Elisabeth when she was around 17. The decorations are inspired by East Asian art. It's a stunning portrait filled with ornament.
mademoiselle-v-in-the-costume-of-an-espada

A woman dressed as a bullfighter holds a pink cape in a studio, with a little fight scene behind her. Manet's model, Victorine Meurent, is the same woman from 'Olympia'. It's a playful picture of costume and performance. It shows his love of Spanish art.
wheat-field-with-a-lark

A bird rises above a golden field of waving wheat under a wide sky. Van Gogh painted it in Paris in 1887, and the field swirls in lively brushstrokes. He loved the open countryside. It's a happy, breezy landscape.
salisbury-cathedral-from-the-meadows

The cathedral's slim spire rises beyond a stream and meadow beneath a stormy sky, with a bright rainbow. Constable painted it in 1831, when he was sad about the death of his wife. The dramatic clouds show his feelings. It's one of his grandest landscapes.
reunion-de-famille

Bazille's family are posed on a terrace under the trees at their home in southern France. He painted them in strong sunlight, looking out in rows. The picture was accepted at the Salon of 1868. It's an early step in Impressionism.
landscape-with-a-carriage-and-a-train

A horse-drawn carriage races across a golden field, as a train steams by in the distance, under a cloudy sky. Van Gogh painted it in 1890 in his last weeks. The old and new world are side by side. It's a lively, energetic view of the countryside.
self-portrait-with-dr-arrieta
The elderly Goya, ill and pale, is held by his doctor, who offers him a drink. Goya painted it as thanks to Dr. Arrieta for saving his life. Dark shadows loom behind them. It's a touching tribute.
belisarius-begging-for-alms

An old, blind general, once a great hero, begs on the street as a soldier recognizes him in astonishment. In the story, Belisarius was Rome's top commander who was treated unfairly. David painted it with clear and strong emotions. It's a lesson that glory can vanish.
the-death-of-leonardo-da-vinci

The great artist Leonardo da Vinci lies on his deathbed in France, in the arms of the king, as friends look on. It's a legend, not a proven fact, but Ingres loved the story. The painting is a tribute to a genius. It reflects the great respect for artists in 1800s France.
the-anger-of-achilles

The hero Achilles is furious as Agamemnon takes back a prize, in a scene from Homer's Iliad. David painted it late in his life, in exile, in a rich, sculpted style. The rage is felt in every face. It's a dramatic moment from the Trojan War.
arearea
Women in the Tahitian countryside play music under a red dog's gaze, with a spirit figure in the background. 'Arearea' means 'joyousness.' Gauguin's colors are bold and flat. It's a dreamy scene.
the-young-shepherdess

A barefoot young girl in a rural dress stands in a green field, with a gentle, direct look. Bouguereau painted idealized peasant girls that were very popular. This one is shown with soft, smooth finish. It's a typical beloved image.
a-pilgrimage-to-san-isidro

A dark, ghostly crowd of people sing, stagger and stare out in a wild procession. Goya painted it on a wall of his house as part of the Black Paintings. It's a contrast with his earlier cheerful version of the same festival. It shows how his view of the world had darkened.
luxe-calme-et-volupte

Figures relax on a beach in dots of purple, orange and blue, around a table with a picnic, beneath the bright sun. Matisse got the title from a poem by Baudelaire. He used the dots of Seurat but made them bigger and wilder. It was an important step toward Fauvism.
whistlejacket

A magnificent chestnut horse rears up against a plain background, the size of life. Stubbs painted it for the Marquess of Rockingham, and it is thought that there was no background by design. His knowledge of horse anatomy is astonishing. It is the most famous horse painting in Britain.
dona-joanna-the-mad

A queen in black stands by the coffin of her husband, refusing to let it be buried, in a bleak landscape. Joanna of Castile was the Queen of Spain and was said to be overwhelmed with grief. Pradilla painted the scene in a vast, wild setting. It's a famous work from Spain.
the-burial-of-the-sardine

A crowd in masks and costumes dance and shout in a wild carnival procession. Goya painted it in the 1810s, a festival at the end of Carnival in Madrid. The faces are strange and frightening. It's an energetic piece.
portrait-of-the-marchioness-of-santa-cruz

A Spanish noblewoman lies on a couch, in a classical white dress, with a lyre, as if she were a Muse. Goya painted it with loose brushstrokes and with a cool and gentle mood. It's an original and fresh view of portraits. It's a favorite in Madrid's Prado Museum.
